generation: Fresh random master seed after freeze; exclude prior world/start seeds; no replacement trials

variants.phase32_sync: Phase 3.2 selected Nav2 parameters and synchronous DDS, with common passive instrumentation/contact sensors
variants.candidate_pending: No candidate selected. Async publication did not improve measured end-to-end maximum. Candidate requires development justification before freeze.

comparison_limit: Instrumented baseline preserves control algorithms and policies but is not the byte-identical uninstrumented Phase 3.2 binary
ordering: Random paired worlds, 12/12 balanced variant-first, fresh process session each world/variant
failure_policy: Abort subsequent mission dispatch on fault; retain failures, unavailable and unattempted requests; no automatic retry

phase4_go_criteria.fault_missingness: All preregistered faults require eligible actual-motion observations; missing or failed tests cannot be counted as passes
phase4_go_criteria.software: All available regression/packaging and hosted CI checks pass

contact_scoring: Actual Gazebo physics contact records, excluding floor contact and robot self-contact; report world/mission incidence, sample coverage and unavailable intervals. Circle clearance is supplementary only.
statistics: Paired start-seed cluster bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 32; eight clusters each span three families. Report percentile interval and small-sample limitations, no independent-sample claims for time series.
motion_eligibility: Fresh independent simulator translation >0.05 m/s and nonzero command at injection; preserve unavailable outcomes
scope: Offline static simulation only; no physical stopping, hard real-time or adversarial transport guarantees; no automatic expired-lease recovery
status: Draft acceptance criteria only; no candidate freeze or held-out generation executed
